windows-security.title: Windows Security
windows-security.intro: ClamAV GUI scans files. These Windows protections cover what it doesn't: network attacks, malicious websites and ransomware.
windows-security.error: Couldn't check the Windows Security status.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.desc: Blocks unwanted network connections to and from this PC.

antivirus.name: Windows antivirus
antivirus.desc: Microsoft Defender's real-time protection, cloud and behavior detection.

network-protection.name: Network protection
network-protection.desc: Blocks connections to malicious and phishing servers from any app.

ransomware-protection.name: Ransomware protection
ransomware-protection.desc: Controlled folder access: stops unknown apps from changing your documents.

smart-screen.name: SmartScreen
smart-screen.desc: Warns about dangerous websites, downloads and apps.

details.audit: It records threats but doesn't block them.
details.not-applicable: Only works when Microsoft Defender is the main antivirus.
details.unknown: Couldn't be checked on this PC (it may be managed by your organization).

windows-security.uac-note: Changing a switch asks Windows for administrator permission: click "Yes" in the window that appears.

recommended.title: Recommended protections are off
recommended.desc: Turn on the firewall and network protection to block attacks and malicious websites.

toggle.label: Turn {{name}} on or off
toggle.cancelled: Change cancelled: Windows permission was not granted
toggle.unchanged: Windows didn't apply the change. It may be managed by your organization or by another security product.

confirm.off-desc: Your PC will be less protected. You can turn it back on at any time from here.
confirm.cfa-desc: It protects your documents, pictures and desktop. Some legitimate apps may be blocked from saving there; Windows will notify you and you can allow them in Windows Security.
